** CAUTION: This message has been sent from outside our organization. Please do not click links or open attachments
unless you recognize the source of this email and know the content is safe.
Dear Investor,
Greetings from 360 ONE Asset.
This is with regards to your investment in 360 ONE Special Opportunities Fund - Series 8 (the "Fund")
We are pleased to inform you that the Fund has initiated a net distribution amounting to ~6.90% of the capital
commitment.
A detailed distribution letter, highlighting the details of the payout, will be shared with you in the next 3-5
business days.
Notes:
1. For folios under pledge, distribution proceeds will be credited to the lender's bank account as speci fi ed in
the pledge letter.
2. Any unpaid drawdowns as on may be adjusted against the distribution, in accordance with the Fund
documents.
Should you have any queries or require further assistance, please contact us at +91 22 4876 5158 or write to
alternates@360.one .
Warm Regards,
Investor Desk
360 ONE Alternates Asset Management Limited
